episodes.synopsis: Ayanokoji's second year begins with a new threat from the White Room and a new special test.
episodes.title: Assassin From the White Room

episodes.synopsis: Ayanokoji and Horikita's quest for a partner for Sudo brings them to a first-year with unusual demands.
episodes.title: Contract and Payment

episodes.synopsis: Class 2-D continues its negotiations with Class 1-D as the state of the field becomes more clear.
episodes.title: Determination of a Leader

episodes.synopsis: Negotiations with Hosen come to a head with little time left before the end of the special test.
episodes.title: To Whom the Blade Turns

episodes.synopsis: Ayanokoji manages to avoid a scheme set up by the new first-year students that could have led to expulsion. However, the results of his special exam throw Class 2-D into an uproar, with some even suspecting foul play. Ayanokoji ends up being pressed by his classmates...
episodes.title: The 20 Million Man

episodes.synopsis: The uninhabited island survival exam for this year has been announced. It will last for two weeks, and the island will be larger than last year's. Additionally, students from all grade levels will compete against each other. Before the exam begins, a four-week period is provided for forming groups, sparking a fierce competition among all classes to recruit members.
episodes.title: A Turbulent Battle for Recruitment

episodes.synopsis: The first-years arrange a super team for the upcoming test, but bad blood runs deep between Utomiya and Hosen.
episodes.title: Plotting

episodes.synopsis: With the test approaching, Ayanokoji attracts attention from third-years and Ryuen.
episodes.title: The Subject of the Dragons' Gaze

episodes.synopsis: The deserted island special test finally begins.
episodes.title: A Disquieting Beginning

episodes.synopsis: The special test begins in earnest as Ayanokoji takes the state of the game and aids a struggling teammate.
episodes.title: Love Uncommunicated

episodes.synopsis: After hearing the watch alarm, Ayanokoji and the others discover the first students to withdraw.
episodes.title: Connection

episodes.synopsis: Ayanokoji and Nanase's latest journey takes them over the mountains, where dramatic revelations are made.
episodes.title: After Vengeance

episodes.synopsis: Amasawa confronts Ayanokoji and reveals her connection to the White Room.
episodes.title: Obscured by the Rain

episodes.synopsis: The third-years make their move to try to dominate the test's top three slots.
episodes.title: The Extraordinary Prodigy

episodes.synopsis: The first-years make a big move to take down solo-team stragglers... starting with Ayanokoji!
episodes.title: Power and Will

episodes.synopsis: While Amasawa delays Horikita, Ayanokoji arrives at the I2 area where a climactic showdown awaits.
episodes.title: For a Desired Future
